title: roster_entry
description: One identity in the organization's authoritative workforce directory — the directory the project designates as its roster (Okta, Microsoft Entra ID, Google Workspace, Active Directory). Lifecycle policies check accounts in other systems against these entries. status: active = can sign in; pending = provisioned but cannot sign in yet (a joiner); inactive = suspended, disabled, deprovisioned or expired. email is the join key: an entry without one can never vouch for an account, so that person's accounts surface as unlinked rather than passing. additionalProperties is false on purpose: this is personnel data, so plugins emit only the fields listed here (data minimisation).

id.description: Stable identifier within the emitting directory (Okta user id, Entra object id, Google user id, AD objectGUID).

status.description: Normalized account state; see the type description.

email.description: Primary work email, or the user principal name when the directory has no mailbox address. Not format-validated because UPNs need not be deliverable.

employee_id.description: Organization-assigned employee identifier, when the directory carries one.

employee_type.description: Organization-to-person relationship as recorded by the directory (employee, contractor, …).

is_service_account.description: The entry is a non-human identity. Omitted when the directory has no signal.

source_status.description: The directory's own status value the normalized status was derived from, for auditability (e.g. Okta SUSPENDED, AD disabled).
